name: Noka Cheese
description: Noka Cheese is a calm, photographic WordPress store theme for an independent cheese counter. A pale willow ground is ruled by three dotted guides and a double-line menu glyph, double-rim pebble photographs sit beside the text, a catalogue of style cards runs next to a sticky pebble, and a paper arch band closes the page. Albert Sans and Instrument Sans, optional WooCommerce for board reservations and pickup, and a newsletter form that works with or without a plugin.
